# Prescriptive lessons — barry-galbraith × jazz-solo-guitar

_No per-chord-quality prescriptive lessons extracted. Galbraith's *42 Chord Melody Arrangements for Solo Guitar* is a performance anthology — no prose commentary, no explanatory chapters, no labeled techniques, no stated methodology. The single chapter is the complete book: 42 fully notated chord-melody arrangements of jazz standards. Pedagogical structure is entirely implicit; extracting prescriptive lessons would require notation-level analysis of the 42 arrangements. The masters.json placeholder-shape system (from #432) remains canonical until notation-tooling exists._
